qa_pairs.question: If mid-tier influencers A and B on Weibo both have a total of 1 million followers at the beginning of the year. What is the absolute value of the difference in the number of followers of A and B at the end of the year? The unit is in ten thousands, and keep 1 decimal place.
qa_pairs.explanation: Influencer A's follower growth rate is 75.9%, so the number of followers at the end of the year = 100 × (1 + 75.9%) = 1.759 million; Influencer B's follower loss rate is 3.7%, so the number of followers at the end of the year = 100 × (1 - 3.7%) = 0.963 million.
